operations.name: Conrad de Jesus

expected.charges: False imprisonment, obstruction of a thoroughfare, unlawful assembly
expected.sentence: August 21, 2026: 30 days, split between jail and a work program; six months probation. Jail stayed pending appeal; outstanding charges dismissed. Four pretrial days credited.
